passages.text: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem, and the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in the holy city of Jerusalem, while the remaining nine were to dwell in their own towns.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is the holy city.
The rest of the people did not settle there.
The rest of the people cast lots.
They chose one out of every ten people.
The chosen person would live in Jerusalem.
The other nine people would live in their own towns.
passages.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי־ הָעָ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּשְׁאָ֣ר הָ֠עָם הִפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת לְהָבִ֣יא׀ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־ הָעֲשָׂרָ֗ה לָשֶׁ֙בֶת֙ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְתֵ֥שַׁע הַיָּד֖וֹת בֶּעָרִֽים׃

passages.text: And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The people gave a blessing.
They blessed all the men.
These men volunteered.
They chose to live in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַֽיְבָרֲכ֖וּ הָעָ֑ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַמִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ים לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: These are the heads of the provinces who settled in Jerusalem. (In the villages of Judah, however, each lived on his own property in their towns—the Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants, and descendants of Solomon’s servants— while some of the descendants of Judah and Benjamin settled in Jerusalem.) From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez; and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.
passages.sermon:
The heads of the provinces settled in Jerusalem.
Other people lived in the villages of Judah.
Each man lived on his own property in his own town.
These people included Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants, and descendants of Solomon’s servants.
Some descendants of Judah and Benjamin settled in Jerusalem.
From the descendants of Judah, Athaiah lived in Jerusalem.
Athaiah was the son of Uzziah.
Uzziah was the son of Zechariah.
Zechariah was the son of Amariah.
Amariah was the son of Shephatiah.
Shephatiah was the son of Mahalalel.
Athaiah was a descendant of Perez.
Maaseiah also lived in Jerusalem.
Maaseiah was the son of Baruch.
Baruch was the son of Col-hozeh.
Col-hozeh was the son of Hazaiah.
Hazaiah was the son of Adaiah.
Adaiah was the son of Joiarib.
Joiarib was the son of Zechariah.
Maaseiah was a descendant of Shelah.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּבְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ בַּאֲחֻזָּתוֹ֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃ וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ מִבְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן מִבְּנֵ֣י יְ֠הוּדָה עֲתָיָ֨ה בֶן־ עֻזִּיָּ֜ה בֶּן־ זְכַרְיָ֧ה בֶן־ אֲמַרְיָ֛ה בֶּן־ שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן־ מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל מִבְּנֵי־ פָֽרֶץ׃ וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֣ה בֶן־ בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־ כָּל־ חֹ֠זֶה בֶּן־ חֲזָיָ֨ה בֶן־ עֲדָיָ֧ה בֶן־ יוֹיָרִ֛יב בֶּן־ זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ הַשִּׁלֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: The descendants of Perez who settled in Jerusalem totaled 468 men of valor.
passages.sermon: The descendants of Perez lived in Jerusalem.\r\nThere were 468 men from this group.\r\nThese men were men of valor.
passages.original: כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ פֶ֕רֶץ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֛וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁי־ חָֽיִל׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah; and his followers Gabbai and Sallai—928 men.
passages.sermon:
The following men were descendants of Benjamin.
Sallu was one of them.
Sallu was the son of Meshullam.
Meshullam was the son of Joed.
Joed was the son of Pedaiah.
Pedaiah was the son of Kolaiah.
Kolaiah was the son of Maaseiah.
Maaseiah was the son of Ithiel.
Ithiel was the son of Jeshaiah.
Gabbai and Sallai followed Sallu.
There were 928 men in total.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן סַלֻּ֡א בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֡ם בֶּן־ יוֹעֵ֡ד בֶּן־ פְּדָיָה֩ בֶן־ ק֨וֹלָיָ֧ה בֶן־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן־ אִֽיתִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ יְשַֽׁעְיָֽה׃ וְאַחֲרָ֖יו גַּבַּ֣י סַלָּ֑י תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: Joel son of Zichri was the officer over them, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the Second District of the city.
passages.sermon:
Joel was the son of Zichri.
Joel served as the officer over the descendants of Benjamin in Jerusalem.
Judah was the son of Hassenuah.
Judah was in charge of the Second District of the city.
passages.original: וְיוֹאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ זִכְרִ֖י פָּקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וִיהוּדָ֧ה בֶן־ הַסְּנוּאָ֛ה עַל־ הָעִ֖יר מִשְׁנֶֽה׃פ

passages.text: From the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib; Jachin; Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of the house of God; and their associates who did the work at the temple—822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and his associates, the leaders of families—242 men; Amashai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer; and his associates —128 mighty men of valor. Zabdiel son of Haggedolim was their overseer.
passages.sermon:
The following men were priests.
Jedaiah was the son of Joiarib.
Jachin was also a priest.
Seraiah was the son of Hilkiah.
Hilkiah was the son of Meshullam.
Meshullam was the son of Zadok.
Zadok was the son of Meraioth.
Meraioth was the son of Ahitub.
Seraiah was the chief official of the house of God.
These priests had associates.
Their associates did the work at the temple.
There were 822 men who did this work.
Adaiah was the son of Jeroham.
Jeroham was the son of Pelaliah.
Pelaliah was the son of Amzi.
Amzi was the son of Zechariah.
Zechariah was the son of Pashhur.
Pashhur was the son of Malchijah.
Adaiah had associates.
His associates were leaders of families.
There were 242 of these men.
Amashai was the son of Azarel.
Azarel was the son of Ahzai.
Ahzai was the son of Meshillemoth.
Meshillemoth was the son of Immer.
Amashai had associates.
His associates were mighty men of valor.
There were 128 of these men.
Zabdiel was the son of Haggedolim.
Zabdiel was the overseer of these men.
passages.original: מִן־ הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה בֶן־ יוֹיָרִ֖יב יָכִֽין׃ שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן־ חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־ צָד֗וֹק בֶּן־ מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם עֹשֵׂ֤י הַמְּלָאכָה֙ לַבַּ֔יִת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַ֠עֲדָיָה בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֤ם בֶּן־ פְּלַלְיָה֙ בֶּן־ אַמְצִ֣י בֶן־ זְכַרְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־ מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃ וְאֶחָיו֙ רָאשִׁ֣ים לְאָב֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַעֲמַשְׁסַ֧י בֶּן־ עֲזַרְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־ אַחְזַ֥י בֶּן־ מְשִׁלֵּמ֖וֹת בֶּן־ אִמֵּֽר׃ וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וּפָקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם זַבְדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ הַגְּדוֹלִֽים׃ס

passages.text: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni; Shabbethai and Jozabad, two leaders of the Levites, who supervised the work outside the house of God; Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served in the holy city.
Shemaiah was a Levite.
Shemaiah was the son of Hasshub.
Hasshub was the son of Azrikam.
Azrikam was the son of Hashabiah.
Hashabiah was the son of Bunni.
Shabbethai was a leader among the Levites.
Jozabad was also a leader among the Levites.
Shabbethai and Jozabad supervised the work outside the house of God.
Mattaniah was a Levite.
Mattaniah was the son of Mica.
Mica was the son of Zabdi.
Zabdi was the son of Asaph.
Mattaniah led in giving thanks and in prayer.
Bakbukiah was a Levite.
Bakbukiah was second among his associates.
Abda was a Levite.
Abda was the son of Shammua.
Shammua was the son of Galal.
Galal was the son of Jeduthun.
passages.original: וּמִֽן־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה בֶן־ חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־ עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־ חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ בּוּנִּֽי׃ וְשַׁבְּתַ֨י וְיוֹזָבָ֜ד עַל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצֹנָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵרָאשֵׁ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ וּמַתַּנְיָ֣ה בֶן־ מִ֠יכָה בֶּן־ זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן־ אָסָ֜ף רֹ֗אשׁ הַתְּחִלָּה֙ יְהוֹדֶ֣ה לַתְּפִלָּ֔ה וּבַקְבֻּקְיָ֖ה מִשְׁנֶ֣ה מֵאֶחָ֑יו וְעַבְדָּא֙ בֶּן־ שַׁמּ֔וּעַ בֶּן־ גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־ יְדִיתוּן׃

passages.text: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.
passages.sermon: The Levites lived in the holy city.\r\nTheir total number was 284.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּעִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃פ

passages.text: And the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men.
passages.sermon:
Akkub and Talmon were gatekeepers.
Their associates also served as gatekeepers.
These men kept watch at the gates.
There were 172 gatekeepers in total.
passages.original: וְהַשּֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ עַקּ֣וּב טַלְמ֔וֹן וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֑ים מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the villages of Judah, each on his own inheritance.
passages.sermon:
The rest of the Israelites lived in the villages of Judah.
The priests lived in the villages of Judah.
The Levites lived in the villages of Judah.
Each person lived on his own inheritance.
passages.original: וּשְׁאָ֨ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּכָל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, with Ziha and Gishpa over them.
passages.sermon: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel.\r\nZiha and Gishpa supervised the temple servants.
passages.original: וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּעֹ֑פֶל וְצִיחָ֥א וְגִשְׁפָּ֖א עַל־ הַנְּתִינִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Now the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica. He was one of Asaph’s descendants, who were the singers in charge of the service of the house of God.
passages.sermon:
Uzzi was the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem.
Uzzi was the son of Bani.
Bani was the son of Hashabiah.
Hashabiah was the son of Mattaniah.
Mattaniah was the son of Mica.
Uzzi was a descendant of Asaph.
Asaph’s descendants were singers.
These singers were in charge of the service in the house of God.
passages.original: וּפְקִ֤יד הַלְוִיִּם֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עֻזִּ֤י בֶן־ בָּנִי֙ בֶּן־ חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ מַתַּנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ מִיכָ֑א מִבְּנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים לְנֶ֖גֶד מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: For there was a command from the king concerning the singers, an ordinance regulating their daily activities.
passages.sermon:
The king gave a command about the singers.
He set a rule for them.
This rule told them what to do each day.
The singers followed this rule every day.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲמָנָ֥ה עַל־ הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, a descendant of Zerah son of Judah, was the king’s agent in every matter concerning the people.
passages.sermon:
Pethahiah was the son of Meshezabel.
Pethahiah was a descendant of Zerah.
Zerah was the son of Judah.
Pethahiah served as the king’s agent.
Pethahiah handled every matter concerning the people.
passages.original: וּפְתַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶּן־ מְשֵֽׁיזַבְאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵי־ זֶ֤רַח בֶּן־ יְהוּדָה֙ לְיַ֣ד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְכָל־ דָּבָ֖ר לָעָֽם׃

passages.text: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel, and their villages; in Jeshua, Moladah, and Beth-pelet; in Hazar-shual; in Beersheba and its villages; in Ziklag; in Meconah and its villages; in En-rimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth, Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages; in Lachish and its fields; and in Azekah and its villages. So they settled from Beersheba all the way to the Valley of Hinnom.
passages.sermon:
Some of the people of Judah lived in villages and their fields.
They lived in Kiriath-arba and its villages.
They lived in Dibon and its villages.
They lived in Jekabzeel and its villages.
They lived in Jeshua.
They lived in Moladah.
They lived in Beth-pelet.
They lived in Hazar-shual.
They lived in Beersheba and its villages.
They lived in Ziklag.
They lived in Meconah and its villages.
They lived in En-rimmon.
They lived in Zorah.
They lived in Jarmuth.
They lived in Zanoah.
They lived in Adullam and its villages.
They lived in Lachish and its fields.
They lived in Azekah and its villages.
They settled in the land from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ הַחֲצֵרִ֖ים בִּשְׂדֹתָ֑ם מִבְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ בְּקִרְיַ֤ת הָֽאַרְבַּע֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבְדִיבֹן֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבִֽיקַּבְצְאֵ֖ל וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃ וּבְיֵשׁ֥וּעַ וּבְמוֹלָדָ֖ה וּבְבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט׃ וּבַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבִבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃ וּבְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּבִמְכֹנָ֖ה וּבִבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃ וּבְעֵ֥ין רִמּ֛וֹן וּבְצָרְעָ֖ה וּבְיַרְמֽוּת׃ זָנֹ֤חַ עֲדֻלָּם֙ וְחַצְרֵיהֶ֔ם לָכִישׁ֙ וּשְׂדֹתֶ֔יהָ עֲזֵקָ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ מִבְּאֵֽר־ שֶׁ֖בַע עַד־ גֵּֽיא־ הִנֹּֽם׃

passages.text: The descendants of Benjamin from Geba lived in Michmash, Aija, and Bethel with its villages; in Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah, Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim, Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat, Lod, and Ono; and in the Valley of the Craftsmen.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Benjamin lived in many places.
They came from Geba.
They lived in Michmash.
They lived in Aija.
They lived in Bethel and its villages.
They lived in Anathoth.
They lived in Nob.
They lived in Ananiah.
They lived in Hazor.
They lived in Ramah.
They lived in Gittaim.
They lived in Hadid.
They lived in Zeboim.
They lived in Neballat.
They lived in Lod.
They lived in Ono.
They lived in the Valley of the Craftsmen.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִגָּ֑בַע מִכְמָ֣שׂ וְעַיָּ֔ה וּבֵֽית־ אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃ עֲנָת֥וֹת נֹ֖ב עֲנָֽנְיָֽה׃ חָצ֥וֹר׀ רָמָ֖ה גִּתָּֽיִם׃ חָדִ֥יד צְבֹעִ֖ים נְבַלָּֽט׃ לֹ֥ד וְאוֹנ֖וֹ גֵּ֥י הַחֲרָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: And some divisions of the Levites of Judah settled in Benjamin.
passages.sermon: Some Levites belonged to Judah.\r\nSome of these Levites lived in Benjamin.\r\nThese Levites were organized in divisions.
